misprints.note: Headword printed 'Träda' (and 'Träde', 'Påträda'); kept as printed. The fallow-land sense is normally spelled 'Träda/Träde', so this is probably not an error.

misprints.probably_meant: b) fig. (with an a) before it)
misprints.note: Sense 1) of Träffa has 'b) fig.' but no 'a)' anywhere before it.

misprints.printed: ἐμ / πίπτειν (line break with no hyphen)
misprints.note: The word is split across a line end without a hyphen. Written whole as ἐμπίπτειν.

misprints.printed: ἦν τι πάθω. ἦν τί μοι συμβῇ. ἦν τι γένηται
misprints.note: The conditional ἤν/ἐάν is printed with what looks like a circumflex. Kept as printed.

uncertain.note: The accent looks like an acute (the standard form is σκῶρ). Transcribed as an acute, as it appears in the scan.
After the 'l' the scan shows something like a comma ('l,'), probably a broken full stop. Transcribed as 'l.'.
The first part 'ἐμ' could carry a smooth breathing with grave or acute. The word was joined across the unhyphenated line break.
